```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Figures and tables requested by the reviewers. Render climate analyses.Rmd
# and model_checks.Rmd first; they write figures/ and tables/.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", out.width = "100%")
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)

read_table <- function(file) read.csv(file.path("tables", file))
figure <- function(name) file.path("figures", paste0(name, ".pdf"))

xylem_stats <- read.csv("data/xylem_stats.csv")
sample_structure <- read_table("sample_structure_per_taxon.csv")
model_parameters <- read_table("model_parameters.csv")
model_comparison <- read_table("model_comparison.csv")
random_ci <- read_table("random_effect_ci.csv")
random_tests <- read_table("random_effect_tests.csv")
genus_slope_table <- read_table("genus_slopes.csv")
convergence <- read_table("model_convergence.csv")
residual_tests <- read_table("residual_tests.csv")
leave_one_out <- read_table("leave_one_genus_out.csv")
sensitivity <- read_table("sensitivity_large_genera.csv")

f1 <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 1)
f2 <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2)
f3 <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)
p_value <- function(p) case_when(is.na(p) ~ "", p < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001", TRUE ~ f3(p))
ci <- function(low, high, format = f2) paste0(format(low), " to ", format(high))
pct_doubling <- function(b) 100 * (2^b - 1)

trait_label <- c(Dh = "D\\textsubscript{h}", VLF = "VLF")
term_label <- c(
  "(Intercept)" = "Intercept",
  genus_mean_MAP = "$b_{across}$",
  diff_from_genus_MAP = "$b_{within}$",
  log_MAP = "$b_{pooled}$"
)

# Typographic minus sign for negative numbers in table cells
minus <- function(x) gsub("(^|[ (])-(?=[0-9.])", "\\1$-$", x, perl = TRUE)

si_table <- function(data, caption, align = NULL, ...) {
  data |>
    mutate(across(where(is.character), minus)) |>
    kbl(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, linesep = "",
        caption = caption, align = align, ...) |>
    kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position", font_size = 8)
}

# Italic genus, epithet and infraspecific epithet; roman rank and authority
italic_name <- function(name) {
  words <- strsplit(name, " ")[[1]]
  italic <- seq_along(words) <= 2
  rank <- which(words %in% c("subsp.", "var.", "f."))
  if (length(rank) > 0) italic[rank[1] + 1] <- TRUE
  words <- str_replace_all(words, "&", "\\\\&")
  words[italic] <- paste0("\\textit{", words[italic], "}")
  paste(words, collapse = " ")
}
```

```{r table-s1}
taxa_per_tree_count <- cut(sample_structure$trees, c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, Inf),
                           labels = c("1", "2", "3", "4-5", "6-10", "> 10"))
tree_distribution <- table(taxa_per_tree_count)
tibble(
  Quantity = c("Taxa", "Genera", "Families", "Trees (slides)", "Images",
               "Trees per taxon, mean (median, range)", "Images per tree",
               paste("Taxa with", names(tree_distribution),
                     ifelse(names(tree_distribution) == "1", "tree", "trees"))),
  Value = c(
    nrow(xylem_stats), n_distinct(xylem_stats$genus), n_distinct(xylem_stats$family),
    format(sum(sample_structure$trees), big.mark = ","),
    format(sum(sample_structure$images), big.mark = ","),
    sprintf("%.1f (%d, %d-%d)", mean(sample_structure$trees),
            as.integer(median(sample_structure$trees)),
            min(sample_structure$trees), max(sample_structure$trees)),
    f2(sum(sample_structure$images) / sum(sample_structure$trees)),
    as.vector(tree_distribution)
  )
) |>
  si_table("Sample structure.", align = "lr")
```

```{r table-s2}
model_parameters |>
  filter(Effects == "fixed", !is.na(z)) |>
  transmute(
    Trait = trait_label[trait], Model = str_to_sentence(model),
    Term = term_label[Parameter], Estimate = f3(Coefficient), SE = f3(SE),
    `95\\% CI` = ci(CI_low, CI_high, f3), z = f2(z), P = p_value(p),
    `\\% per MAP doubling (95\\% CI)` = ifelse(
      Parameter == "(Intercept)", "",
      paste0(f1(pct_doubling(Coefficient)), " (",
             ci(pct_doubling(CI_low), pct_doubling(CI_high), f1), ")")
    )
  ) |>
  si_table("Fixed effects of the mixed and pooled models (natural-log traits and MAP).",
           align = "lllrrlrrl") |>
  collapse_rows(columns = 1:2, latex_hline = "major", valign = "top")
```

```{r table-s3}
model_comparison |>
  transmute(
    Trait = trait_label[trait], Model = str_to_sentence(model), n,
    Parameters = parameters, `log-likelihood` = f2(logLik), AIC = f2(AIC),
    `$\\Delta$AIC` = f2(delta_AIC), BIC = f2(BIC),
    `Marginal R\\textsuperscript{2}` = f3(r2_marginal),
    `Conditional R\\textsuperscript{2}` = ifelse(is.na(r2_conditional), "", f3(r2_conditional))
  ) |>
  si_table("Fit of the mixed and pooled models (maximum likelihood, same 480 taxa).",
           align = "llrrrrrrrr") |>
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major", valign = "top")
```

```{r table-s4}
ci_label <- c(
  "Std.Dev.(Intercept)|family" = "Family intercept (SD)",
  "Std.Dev.(Intercept)|genus" = "Genus intercept (SD)",
  "Std.Dev.diff_from_genus_MAP|genus" = "Genus slope (SD)",
  "Cor.diff_from_genus_MAP.(Intercept)|genus" = "Genus intercept-slope correlation"
)
test_for <- c(
  "Family intercept (SD)" = "Family random intercept",
  "Genus intercept (SD)" = "Genus random intercept",
  "Genus slope (SD)" = "Genus random slope (variance and correlation)"
)
random_ci |>
  mutate(Term = ci_label[parameter], test = test_for[Term]) |>
  left_join(random_tests, by = c("trait", "test")) |>
  transmute(
    Trait = trait_label[trait], Term, Estimate = f3(estimate),
    `95\\% CI` = ci(conf.low, conf.high, f2),
    `LRT $\\chi^2$ (df)` = ifelse(is.na(chisq), "", sprintf("%.1f (%d)", chisq, df)),
    P = p_value(p)
  ) |>
  si_table("Random effects of the mixed models, with 95\\% Wald CIs and likelihood-ratio tests (LRT).",
           align = "llrlrr") |>
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major", valign = "top")
```

```{r table-s6}
checks <- convergence |> left_join(residual_tests, by = "trait")
check_rows <- list(
  "Optimiser message" = checks$optimiser_message,
  "Hessian positive definite" = ifelse(checks$hessian_positive_definite, "Yes", "No"),
  "Singular fit" = ifelse(checks$singular_fit, "Yes", "No"),
  "DHARMa uniformity (Kolmogorov--Smirnov), P" = f3(checks$uniformity_KS_p),
  "DHARMa dispersion, P" = f3(checks$dispersion_p),
  "DHARMa outliers (bootstrap), P" = f2(checks$outliers_p),
  "DHARMa quantiles against fitted values, P" = f3(checks$quantiles_vs_fitted_p),
  "Normality of conditional residuals, P" = p_value(checks$normality_p),
  "Heteroscedasticity, P" = f3(checks$heteroscedasticity_p)
)
tibble(Check = names(check_rows)) |>
  bind_cols(as_tibble(do.call(rbind, check_rows),
                      .name_repair = ~ unname(trait_label[checks$trait]))) |>
  si_table("Convergence and residual tests of the mixed models.", align = "lrr")
```

    `Largest change (SE)` = f2(max(abs(c(across_change_se, within_change_se)))),
    `Genus with largest change` = paste0(
      "\\textit{",
      genus_removed[which.max(pmax(abs(across_change_se), abs(within_change_se)))],
      "}"
    ),
    `Refits with $b_{across}$ P > 0.05` = sum(across_p > 0.05),
    `Refits with $b_{within}$ P < 0.05` = sum(within_p < 0.05),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(trait = trait_label[trait]) |>
  rename(Trait = trait) |>
  si_table("Mixed models refitted without one genus at a time. Changes are in units of the full-model SE.",
           align = "llllrrr") |>
  column_spec(2:7, width = "2cm")
